dependencies.artifact: one durable qm8 terminal-dispatch activation intent
dependencies.required_evidence: The canonical intent or one unique unfinished transaction archive validates, hashes to the transaction ID, binds the exact terminal receipt and dispatch contract, and names the exact planning and full-1G lock inodes.

Every surviving exact lock payload names the original owner PID and terminal receipt; rollback requires both payloads, while committed recovery permits only the dispatcher-ordered planning-absent/full-1G-present state. Any live or reused owner PID rejects recovery.

Without an activation receipt, the selected/displaced pair is dormant/absent, activated/dormant, or dormant/activated. With an activation receipt, the complete helper-verified activation chain remains intact.

contract.transaction_id_rule: SHA-256 of the exact immutable activation-intent bytes; every recovery artifact is named by this digest, allowing later activation attempts to retain disjoint crash evidence.
contract.preparation_rule: Before any plan or intent rename, rescan process, cgroup, and lease closure under the surviving full-1G lock and publish a schema-valid preparation that binds the canonical intent, current selected/displaced/non-selected plans, optional activation receipt, recovery and dispatch contracts, both lock records, observed lock presence, and the dead dispatcher owner PID.
contract.rollback_rule: If no activation receipt exists, reverse only an exact activated/dormant exchange, retain any aborted activated plan at the transaction-addressed archive, move the exact dispatch intent to its transaction archive, require the selected and non-selected plans to be the exact dormant revisions, and require all canonical activation artifacts to be absent.
contract.committed_rule: If the activation receipt exists, independently validate the complete receipt-intent-plan-displaced-plan chain through the frozen closure helper and leave every authority-bearing activation artifact unchanged.
contract.completion_rule: Rescan process, cgroup, and lease closure immediately before the state action, then publish a durable completion only while descriptors for every surviving exact intent-bound lock inode remain valid. Rollback requires both locks; committed activation recovery also accepts the dispatcher-ordered state in which planning was released and full-1G remains. Completion grants no verifier or promotion authority.
contract.release_rule: After completion, remove a lock only if its current single-link regular-file inode, device, and payload hash equal the intent record. An absent exact lock may be recorded only as already_absent_after_completion on crash resumption; any different occupant fails closed. Publish finalization only after both lock paths are absent.

activation_requirements: Never run while qm8 or the original dispatcher owner is live.
Use only after a durable dispatch intent exists and the original dispatcher failed to publish a cleanly unlocked terminal state.
Inspect and commit every recovery preparation, completion, and finalization before any verifier execution.
A rollback permits a fresh dispatcher attempt only; a committed finalization preserves the already selected verifier branch.
Do not infer q1 qualification, Arm-B authority, archive value, or score credit from recovery.
claim_boundary: This frozen source is a liveness and provenance transaction, not a compression mechanism or qm8 measurement.
It has not been executed; qm8 remains live and no terminal receipt or dispatch intent exists.
Recovery cannot invoke a verifier, signal a process, create Arm B, alter a candidate, or award any Hutter or Gamma score credit.
